name: XOnlinePayment
caption: Əlavə modullar / Ödənişlər və köçürmələr / Terminal ödənişləri

datasets.name: Ods_wspayment
datasets.sql:
select  terminal_type,id ,account,creditid,Amount,rrn,currency,customer,respdatetime,sys_date,payment_id,status, paymethod, filial from(
select terminal_type,id ,account,creditid,Amount,rrn,currency,customer,respdatetime,sys_date,payment_id,1 as status, paymethod, filial from terminal_payments
union
select terminal_type,id ,account,creditid,Amount,rrn,currency,customer,respdatetime,sys_date,'0' as payment_id,0 as status, paymethod,filial from terminal_temppayments)










order by respdatetime

datasets.name: ods_arxipayment
datasets.sql:
select p.* from ws_payment p where trunc(sys_date)=:v_dat

order by sys_date desc

datasets.name: Ods_wssysdate
datasets.sql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(sysdate, 'HH24:MI') AS saat, sysdate
FROM dual

datasets.name: ods_combolist
datasets.sql:
select  'Bütün Hamısı' terminal_type from  terminal_arctemppayments
Union 
select  distinct terminal_type  from  terminal_arcpayments

datasets.name: Ods_wspaymentarch
datasets.sql:
select  terminal_type,id ,account,creditid,Amount,rrn,currency,customer,respdatetime,sys_date,payment_id,status,  paymethod, filial from(
select terminal_type,id ,account,creditid,Amount,rrn,currency,customer,respdatetime,sys_date,payment_id,1 as status, paymethod,filial from terminal_arcpayments
union
select terminal_type,id ,account,creditid,Amount,rrn,currency,customer,respdatetime,sys_date,'0' as payment_id,0 as status, paymethod, filial from terminal_arctemppayments)
where trunc(sys_date) between :v_dat and :v_dat2









order by respdatetime

datasets.name: Payment
datasets.sql:
select 
       customer,
       cr.creditid,
       cr.rest,
       cr.duerest,
       cr.interestrest,
       cr.dueinterestrest,
      (select ostat from tenostat where acc_id=a.booroweraccid)ostat

from terminal_arcpayments ta,cm_curr_state cr,cm_accounts a where sys_date>=sbop.PRED_DATE and sys_date<=sbop.get_date and ta.creditid=cr.creditid and ta.creditid=a.creditid
